profiles.description: Standard reserves, separated field evidence, chartered custodianship, ordinary timing, and an unverified convoy claim.
Only two reserve tanks and three days of cistern supply remain when the pump fails.

pump_failure.public_observation: The lift pump fails during a dry week with only three days of cistern supply and two reserve tanks. Covering every district now competes sharply with preserving water for vulnerable households.

profiles.description: The technician's longer repair forecast is public at entry instead of seat-private.

private_observations.custodian: The public shaft forecast still leaves uncertainty about the exact repair day.
private_observations.technician: Your shaft inspection supports the public two-to-four-day forecast.

profiles.description: The custodian holds a narrow emergency delegation and must escalate permanent exceptions.

custodian.role: Deputy emergency custodian with temporary allocation authority and explicit escalation duties

private_observations.custodian: Your delegation permits reversible emergency allocations but not a permanent rewrite of the restricted cistern register.

profiles.description: The western clinic will run dry within four hours, before routine replenishment can arrive.

clinic_shortage.text: The western clinic will exhaust its stored water within four hours without delivery.

allocation_decision.public_observation: The repair will take days and the western clinic will run dry within four hours. Ordinary districts, the restricted cistern, and the convoy also compete under an uncertain southern-channel test.

profiles.description: The governor overstates the convoy's repair need and withholds its large ceremonial allocation.

convoy_repair_claim.text: The governor claims the whole convoy needs priority water for repairs while withholding that most requested volume serves ceremonial staff and private security.
